profiles.name: Ichiro Izuka
profiles.identity_verification: JCCH indexed primary record: 1911-born Nisei Eleele Kauai longshoreman and union organizer, brother Kuichi. Wailua detention, parole August 1942, parole release September 1943. Later Reinecke case witness and 1990 gubernatorial candidate.
profiles.notes: JCCH indexed full text reviewed; no gallery in retrieved record. ILWU history gives text about Izuka but no identified portrait of him. Densho article retrieval HTTP 403. Berkeley Tony Gomez 1942 Tanforan image depicts Mrs Ichiro Iizuka and Henry Livingston, not this man; rejected. Kuichi obituary mentions brother Ichiro but is not his portrait.
unresolved_leads: 1990 Hawaii election candidate photographs or independently captioned union/1948 witness news photograph.
